title: Project Config
description: Project-specific configuration: hooks, health checks, fixtures, and platform commands. Referenced by pool slots via the 'project' field.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

name.description: Project identifier. Must match the directory name under projects/.

type.description: Project type. 'monorepo' projects have multiple apps, 'standalone' is a single app.

prepare.description: Named prepare profiles (ADR-037): project-defined variations of slot preparation. Each profile selects a subset of the optional cost phases, may override hooks for its run, and declares precondition checks with a fallback profile.

default.description: Profile used when no explicit selection is made. Falls back to a profile literally named 'full' when omitted.

description.description: Longer operator-facing help text for profile tooltips and docs.

phases.description: Optional cost phases this profile runs. Safety invariants (ssh, device, tmux, sentinel, origin/HEAD guard) always run.

hooks.description: Per-profile hook overrides; unlisted hooks resolve from the project's top-level hooks.

requires.description: Framework precondition checks that must pass before this profile runs. Any failure falls back to the profile named in 'fallback'.

fallback.description: Profile to run instead when any 'requires' check fails. Required when 'requires' is non-empty; chains must be acyclic.

roadmap.description: Project-specific roadmap refinement settings for ADR-041 idea refinement.

refinement_prompt.description: Inline project-specific roadmap refinement prompt template. Owns backlog draft fan-out/consolidation policy for this project (e.g. prefer smaller PR slices vs framework-style consolidation).

refinement_prompt_path.description: Markdown prompt template path, absolute or relative to projects/<project>/. Defaults to templates/prompts/roadmap-refinement.md when present. Use a project-owned prompt to override draft-count policy (multi-objective same-project tickets, smaller client slices, etc.) without changing the farmslot-farm default.

runner_command.description: Optional command template launched for roadmap refinement. Supports {{runner}}, {{model}}, {{prompt_path}}, and {{item_file}}; if no prompt placeholder is present the prompt path is appended. When omitted, the selected runner is launched in tmux with the rendered prompt as context.

farmslot_command.description: Optional Farmslot CLI executable prefix used when constructing discoverable roadmap commands. Defaults to farmslot; dev checkouts may set this to yarn workspace @farmslot/cli farmslot or another wrapper.

runner.description: Default runner id for roadmap refinement sessions, e.g. claude or codex.

model.description: Default model for roadmap refinement sessions.

default_safety_tier.description: Project-level safety-tier policy (ADR-023 §3). Applied at run create time when neither dispatch params nor a parent run supplies an explicit tier. Runners intrinsically default to 'sandboxed'; set this to 'full-auto' or 'dangerous' to opt the project into a more permissive posture.

recipe_run_supports_playback_slow.description: Opt in when hooks.recipe_run supports the gateway-appended --slow <ms> playback flag. Projects that omit this keep replay commands backwards-compatible even if the UI exposes playback controls.

recipe_run_supports_video_recording.description: Opt in when hooks.recipe_run supports the gateway-appended --record-video=full-run replay flag. Replay surfaces request video by default for supporting projects; projects that omit this keep commands backwards-compatible.

branch_namespace.description: Short namespace prepended to branch names (e.g. 'perps', 'mm'). Produces fix/perps/123-slug.

branch_format.description: Template for branch names. Supports {{type}}, {{ticket}}, {{slug}}, {{namespace}}, {{variant_suffix}} placeholders. Overrides default branch naming (including branch_namespace) when set.

repo_url.description: Git remote URL for the project.

artifacts_repo.description: Public GitHub repo (owner/name) for uploading review/fix/feature artifacts (videos, reports). Files are pushed via git to <flow>/<id>/ paths. Must be public so raw.githubusercontent.com URLs render in PR bodies.

primary_repo.description: Absolute path to the primary (non-worktree) repo clone. Used for monorepo setups.

worktree_base.description: Base directory for git worktrees. Slots may use worktrees under this path.

slot_tracking_branch.description: Template for the idle git branch on linked worktrees (ADR-042). Expanded with slot hook variables such as {{session}}. When omitted on linked worktrees, the gateway derives wt/{{session}}.

merge_main_strategy.description: How prepare integrates default_branch when mergeMain is true (ADR-042). Default merge preserves review-pr abort-on-conflict behavior; rebase is opt-in for linear history.

owner_agent.description: Name of the agent that owns this project, for routing purposes.

reference_repos.description: Related repos cloned alongside the main repo for cross-codebase comparison.

required_paths.description: Paths that must exist in the selected reference snapshot before dispatch can continue.

task_dir.description: Worker-repo task root relative to the slot clone. Overrides paths.artifact_dir when both are set. Gateway and bash lifecycle scripts fall back to paths.artifact_dir, then '.task'.

apps.description: Optional list of canonical app selector values for multi-app projects. These values are passed through Farmslot CLI/UI and injected into hooks/templates via {{app}}. Omit for single-app projects.

paths.description: Directory paths within each worker's repo clone.

runtime_dir.description: Transient process state (logs, PIDs, fixtures). Always gitignored.

artifact_dir.description: Base directory for task files and artifacts on the worker (hook expansion {{artifact_dir}}). Used as the worker task root when task_dir is unset.

recipe_dir.description: Directory for executable recipe harness files synced into the worker repo. Defaults to <runtime_dir>/recipes.

vars.description: Project-level template variables available to hooks, fixtures, and worker task templates.

node_support.description: Optional Farmslot-side support paths to materialize on remote nodes for lifecycle hooks.

paths.description: Farmslot-relative support paths. Allowed roots are scripts/ and validated projects/<name>/ subtrees.

command_env.description: Project-declared environment mutations applied generically before project lifecycle commands and worker runner launches.

unset.description: Environment variable names to unset before running project commands.

set.description: Environment variables to export before running project commands.

domains.description: Optional domain-specific environment overlays applied after the base mutation.

execution_templates.description: Optional shared Markdown execution-template sources and ordered defaults.

eval_harnesses.description: Named external harness sources that eval replay can materialize through existing recipe_harness_* hooks. Keeps Farmslot generic; projects decide which git repo/path or local path backs each harness name.

repo_url.description: Git URL for the harness source repository.

path.description: Path to the harness directory inside repo_url.

local_path.description: Absolute or worker-local path to an already checked out harness directory.

default_ref.description: Default git ref when the eval axis does not request one.

source.description: Human-readable provenance label stored in result package manifests.

preflight_logs.description: Log file paths written by preflight scripts (e.g. xcodebuild, expo). The gateway tails these during prepare and streams output to the UI. Supports {{var}} placeholders. Paths are relative to the worker repo root.

cleanup_patterns.description: Process patterns for pkill -f when cleaning up stale preflight processes after cancel or gateway restart. Supports {{var}} placeholders (patterns with empty vars are skipped). Applied in addition to generic farmslot patterns (preflight.sh, PID files).

diff_analysis.description: Project-specific diff capture/filter settings used when building review inputs and source snapshots.

source_filter.description: Allow/block filters for source diff pathspecs. Omit to use Farmslot defaults.

use_defaults.description: When false, disables built-in source allowlist defaults before applying project filters.

review_input_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for capturing review-input diff artifacts.

hooks.description: Shell commands executed by farmslot lifecycle scripts (orchestrator-side) on the worker machine, inside the slot's repo directory. Use {{var}} placeholders for resource variable substitution.

setup.description: One-time project setup (install deps, build). Run by setup-slot.sh on the worker.
examples: yarn install && cd apps/playground && yarn build:deps

post_merge_install.description: Install dependencies after merging/checking out a branch. Run by prepare-slot.sh on the worker. Default: 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile'.

preflight.description: Pre-dispatch checks and setup (build, start dev server, boot device). Run by prepare-slot.sh on the worker.

health_check.description: Verify the app is running and ready on the worker. Should exit 0 if healthy. Run by prepare-slot.sh and check-slot.sh.

unlock.description: Unlock the app on the worker (e.g., enter wallet password). Run by prepare-slot.sh after health_check passes.

dev_server_check.description: Quick check if the dev server (Metro) is listening on the worker.

artifact_check.description: Fast probe used by prepare profiles to confirm that a requested build artifact is available before slot preparation.

recycle.description: Reset app state between tasks on the worker (e.g., clear app data). Run by `farmslot slot release`. Overridden by pool recycle_cmd.

teardown.description: Stop all slot infrastructure on the worker (dev server, simulator/emulator). Run by `farmslot slot release` (and gateway-free by teardown-slot.sh).

diagnostics.description: Lint/type-check commands. String for single source, object for multi-source (keys = source names).

recipe_action_manifest.description: Command that prints the runner Recipe v1 action manifest JSON for this project/slot. Receives normal slot/project variables such as {{repo}}, {{platform}}, {{cdp_port}}, {{runtime_dir}}, and {{slot_id}}.

recipe_doctor.description: Command that prints a machine-readable Recipe v1 readiness report as JSON. Receives normal slot/project variables such as {{repo}}, {{platform}}, {{cdp_port}}, {{runtime_dir}}, and {{slot_id}}.

recipe_run.description: Command used by the gateway to re-run a selected recipe against a slot. Must explicitly include {{recipe_path}} and {{artifacts_dir}}. Receives {{repo}}, {{cdp_port}}, and other slot/project variables. Set top-level recipe_run_supports_playback_slow=true to opt into gateway-appended --slow <ms> playback flags; set recipe_run_supports_video_recording=true to opt into gateway-appended --record-video=full-run replay flags.

recipe_harness_install.description: Command used by eval replay to install a pinned external recipe harness into a prepared checkout. Receives FARMSLOT_EVAL_HARNESS_* and FARMSLOT_*_DIR environment variables.

recipe_harness_verify.description: Command used by eval replay to verify the injected recipe harness before worker execution.

recipe_harness_cleanup.description: Command used by eval replay to remove the injected recipe harness before product diff capture.

ready_indicator.description: String that the health_check output must contain to indicate readiness.

parse_health.description: Shell command (piped from health_check stdout) to extract the health status string.

dev_server_log.description: Path to the dev server log file. Supports {{runtime_dir}} placeholder.

dev_server_name.description: Display name of the dev server for status messages.

timeouts.description: Per-project preflight/runtime timeouts (seconds). Keys are project-specific and read by that project's setup scripts via get_project_field.

fixtures.description: Files to sync from project fixtures/ to each worker repo.

directories.description: Directories synced via rsync. Useful for injecting entire test/recipe trees.

platforms.description: Platform-specific commands. Keys are platform names (ios, android).

device_check.description: Shell command to check if the device/simulator is running. Exit 0 if present.

recycle.description: Platform-specific recycle command. null if not applicable.

defaults.description: Default runner/model/effort settings per flow type. Overridden by: task file > CLI args > slot config > these defaults.

runner.description: Default runner for this flow type.

model.description: Default model for this flow type.

effort.description: Default effort level for this flow type.

jira.description: Jira integration for issue fetching and batch triage.

email_env.description: Env var name for Jira email authentication.

api_token_env.description: Env var name for Jira API token authentication.

self_review.description: Automated self-review configuration. Spawns a review agent after worker completes to check code quality before human gate. Operator-requested publication reviews are explicit gate work and do not use this enabled flag as a skip.

enabled.description: Whether automatic post-worker self-review is active for this project.

runner.description: Runner for the review agent. Use `same` to reuse the worker's runner.

model.description: LLM model for the review agent.

max_retries.description: Maximum feedback-fix-review cycles before proceeding to human gate.

review_timeout_min.description: Per-pass review-agent timeout in minutes (covers reading the diff + rerunning recipes). Bump if reviews repeatedly time out — publication-gate reviews of large diffs have been observed taking 35-45 minutes.

evidence_prefilter.description: Controls whether historical recipe/evidence matching only suggests prior evidence or may enable autonomous evidence reuse.

min_runs_for_autonomous.description: Minimum historical successful runs before autonomous evidence reuse can be enabled.

models.description: LLM model configuration for gateway intelligence calls.

api_key_env.description: Env var override for API key.

github_secret.description: HMAC secret for GitHub webhook validation.

auto_recycle.description: Automatic health recovery for idle slots.

worker_terminal.description: Worker terminal contract — required SIGNAL.json via ./mark and packaged artifacts per flow/command (ADR-045).

requireSignal.description: When true, worker must write terminal SIGNAL.json via ./mark before the run monitor completes.

flows.description: Per-flow overrides keyed by flow type (dev, fix-bug, review-pr, …).

whenPresent.description: Conditional artifact requirements when a trigger path exists in the task dir.

human_gates.description: Enable/disable human review gates per flow type.

publication_review.description: Local-first publication review policy by flow. Fix-bug defaults to one independent review; autonomous dev defaults to zero unless configured.

minimum_independent_reviews.description: Minimum passing independent reviews before human package approval may publish.

require_cross_runner.description: Require at least one passing review from a different runner; implies at least one required review.

flows.description: Per-flow timeout overrides keyed by FlowType (dev, fix-bug, review-pr, pr-complete, update-branch). Falls back to the top-level monitoring value, then the built-in default. Only total_timeout_min and stuck_timeout_min are overridable; poll_interval_min, idle_timeout_min, and max_nudges stay project-wide.

total_timeout_min.description: Overrides monitoring.total_timeout_min for this flow. Long fix flows (pr-complete, self-review fix passes) commonly need 150+ minutes of legitimate worker time.

slot_actions.description: Project-level slot actions shown in slot UI surfaces. Commands support {{var}} placeholders.

resources.description: Streamable resources (simulators, emulators, browsers) for this project. Keys are resource IDs.

type.description: Semantic resource category: device (simulators/emulators), browser (Chrome instances), dev-server (Metro/Webpack), service (generic daemon).

platform.description: Links to platforms[key] for existing hooks.

streamable.description: Whether this resource supports live screen streaming.

controllable.description: Whether this resource supports boot/shutdown/relaunch controls.

watch.description: How the gateway monitors this resource's liveness.

cmd.description: Shell command returning 0 if alive (for process-poll type).

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks for the resource. Use {{var}} placeholders.

actions.description: Resource-scoped actions shown for this resource.

scoring.description: Bug difficulty scoring configuration. The generic `farmslot bug score` verb delegates to the project-specific script defined here.

script.description: Shell command to run the project's scoring script. Use {{INPUT_FILE}} placeholder for the bug-input.json path.

categories.description: Path (relative to project dir) to the categories/weights JSON config.

grade_prompt.description: Path (relative to project dir) to the LLM grading prompt template. Uses ${VAR} placeholders via envsubst.

ci.description: CI/CD monitoring configuration for watching PR checks and bot comments.

timeout_min.description: Maximum minutes to wait for CI before timing out.

repo.description: GitHub repo in owner/name format for CI checks.

pr_labels.description: Labels to add to PRs created by workers (injected as {{PR_LABELS}} in templates).

pr_title_suffix.description: Optional human-gate suffix appended to PR titles created by workers (injected as {{PR_TITLE_SUFFIX}} in templates). Whitespace is normalized to one leading separator so Conventional Commit title linters still see the commit type first.

watch_checks.description: Legacy CI check names to monitor for pass/fail. Prefer check_groups for deterministic matching and shard aggregation.

check_groups.description: Explicit CI check groups with deterministic match and aggregation semantics.

bot_patterns.description: Patterns for bot comments that trigger actions.

ci_watch.description: CI-watch automation and slot-hold strategy for chained follow-up runs.

max_hold_min.description: Maximum minutes to keep a slot in short CI-watch hold before timing out.

max_total_hold_min.description: Absolute maximum minutes to keep a slot in CI-watch across progress resets.

auto_dispatch.description: Per-category auto-dispatch toggles for CI-watch follow-up runs.

auto_recovery.description: Per-project autonomous recovery policy. Gateway-level LLM settings choose provider/model/auth; this block controls whether this project may use recovery and LLM refinement.

enabled.description: Whether failed terminal runs for this project may be auto-recovered.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum automatic replay attempts per failed step.

allowedSteps.description: Pipeline steps where automatic replay may run. An explicit empty list means no auto-replay steps.

allowedCategories.description: Recoverable failure policy buckets allowed for this project.

disabled_patterns.description: Deterministic failure pattern IDs to suppress for this project.

llm.description: Optional bounded LLM refinement for failures not covered by deterministic patterns.

report.description: Primary worker report path written into SIGNAL.json evidence.reportPath.

artifacts.description: Required non-empty artifact paths relative to the task dir.

fixture_template.description: A fixture file with {{var}} placeholder substitution, or a plain copy/compose entry.

src.description: Source path in the project fixtures/ directory. May contain {{var}} placeholders (e.g. an overlay directory selected per dispatch) resolved at sync time.

dst.description: Destination path relative to the worker repo root.

optional.description: Skip silently when the resolved src does not exist — for overlay fixtures (e.g. domain files) that only some deployments provide.

vars.description: Which resource variables to substitute in this template. If omitted, all variables are available.

compose.description: Compose the destination file from different variants based on a variable.

var.description: Variable name that selects the variant (e.g., FLOW_TYPE).

variants.description: Map of variable value to variant config. Empty string key is the default.

file.description: Source fixture file for this variant.

includes.description: List of files to concatenate. Entries are a path string (required — warns when missing) or {file, optional} where optional entries skip quietly when the resolved path is absent. Paths may contain {{var}} placeholders resolved at sync time.

file.description: Include path relative to the project fixtures/ directory; {{var}} placeholders resolved at sync time.

optional.description: Skip quietly when the resolved path is absent.

fixture_directory.description: A directory synced via rsync from project fixtures/ to worker repo.

src.description: Source path relative to project fixtures/ directory.

dst.description: Destination path relative to the worker repo root.

exclude.description: Patterns to exclude from rsync (e.g., runtime artifacts).

sentinel.description: A file inside the directory used for quick hash-based sync check.

ci_check_group.description: A named CI check group. Supports exact, regex, or substring matching plus aggregation across shards.

name.description: Display name for the group in Farmslot.

match.description: Exact string, substring, or regex pattern depending on match_mode.

slot_action_map.description: Map of action IDs to slot action definitions.

slot_action.description: Operator-triggered command for a slot or resource.

bot_pattern.description: Pattern for matching bot comments on PRs.

author.description: Regex pattern matching the comment author username.

label.description: Human-readable label for this bot type.

action.description: 'nudge_worker' sends the comment to the active agent. 'alert_only' just logs it.

default_action.description: Default action for matching comments when no body-specific action applies.

actions.description: Body-specific overrides for a matched bot author.

body_match.description: Regex matched against the comment body.

label.description: Optional label for this body-specific action.
